أنخلع (form VII)
# أَنْخَلِعُ (ʔanḵaliʕu) /ʔan.xa.li.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
# أَنْخَلِعَ (ʔanḵaliʕa) /ʔan.xa.li.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
# أَنْخَلِعْ (ʔanḵaliʕ) /ʔan.xa.liʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَلَعَ (inḵalaʕa)
